demo.code:
# Install (once, on your Bankr agent)
# install the um-radar skill from https://github.com/BankrBot/skills/tree/main/um-radar

# X.com — tag @bankrbot (examples):
# @$bankrbot $UM-Radar whois @alexdolbun
# @$bankrbot #UMRadar add Waleed Al-Balaa @wballaa
# @$bankrbot $UM-Radar scan Hub71 dinner

# Public GIS lookup (no key)
curl -sL "https://unicornsmap.com/api/radar/alexdolbun.json" | head -c 400

# Whois / profile lookup via Zo bridge
curl -sL "https://alexdolbun.zo.space/api/um-radar?handle=alexdolbun"

setup: Install: install the um-radar skill from https://github.com/BankrBot/skills/tree/main/um-radar
On X: tag @bankrbot with $UM-Radar … or #UMRadar … — skill MUST load before generic tools
Writes/upserts: POST https://alexdolbun.zo.space/api/um-radar/profile (additive registry; no Worker smash)
x402 deep/promote: settle in $UM on Base; never invent GIS URLs
Replies must include bare https://unicornsmap.com/… URLs (X does not render markdown links)
